sources.title: Gaurav-Gosain/tuios repository
sources.finding: Main repository: 6,542 stars on 2026-11-16, MIT per GitHub, default branch main, not archived.

sources.title: tuios README
sources.finding: Modern terminal multiplexer and window manager in Go with vim-like modal interface, BSP tiling, workspaces, daemon sessions, kitty graphics; install via Homebrew, AUR, Nix, install script, go install, Docker and release binaries for Linux, macOS, Windows, FreeBSD and OpenBSD.

sources.title: MIT license file
sources.finding: Repository license is MIT, copyright Gaurav Gosain.

sources.title: Agents in tuios guide
sources.locator: What you get; Set it up; Supported agents; Fleets; Other machines
sources.finding: Per-pane agent states (working, needs_input, idle, done, errored), Inbox across sessions and machines, agent mail, fleets via fan and start-agent, other machines via hosts, grants, MCP server and tmux shim.

sources.title: Supported agents table
sources.finding: Table lists Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, opencode, Kilo, Amp, Pi, oh-my-pi, Kimi Code CLI, Qwen Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, Cursor Agent, Crush and Kiro CLI with how each is read.

sources.title: The MCP server
sources.finding: tuios mcp serves tuios as MCP tools; read-only by default, --write adds send_text, send_keys, ask_agent, respond and fan; scoped to the pane session and enforced by the daemon via restrict-connection.

sources.title: Headless agents over a protocol
sources.locator: section Headless agents over a protocol
sources.finding: start-agent --protocol acp or codex runs an agent headless with tuios as the client; state comes from the protocol; model, context, cost and plan metadata are reported.

sources.title: Resuming after a restart
sources.finding: After a daemon restart the layout returns with new shells; resume offers claude --resume, codex resume or opencode --session per pane (ask, auto or off).

sources.title: Reviewing an agent changes
sources.finding: tuios review shows committed and uncommitted diffs against a base, accepts line notes and sends them to the agent as one message when it rests.

sources.title: Turn checkpoints
sources.finding: Daemon saves the work tree after each turn under refs/tuios/checkpoints; list, diff and restore commands undo a turn.

sources.title: Shipping a worktree
sources.finding: ship commit, merge, pr and status; push and PR need confirm tokens, use the user gh, hold no token; PR and checks shown on the rail; fan keep --merge keeps one attempt.

sources.title: Approvals and risk rules
sources.locator: sections Approvals from the Inbox, Risk rules, Plans, Reject with a reason
sources.finding: Inbox answers approval prompts for opted-in harnesses; risky commands (rm -rf, force push, hard reset, pipe to shell, sudo) need a second press and a risk_ack the daemon enforces.

sources.title: What a pane may do
sources.locator: sections What a pane may do; Who can act as the person
sources.finding: Pane grants (read, write, fan, respond and others) bound what an agent pane can do through tuios; link policy bounds other machines; only the person can answer prompts or send as human.

sources.title: Agents talking to agents
sources.finding: send-agent-message, read-agent-messages, wait-for, ask-agent and ask-human; mail is fenced as untrusted data, in memory only (256 per session) and dies with the daemon.

sources.title: Queued messages
sources.finding: Prompts typed while an agent works can be queued and delivered at rest; mail can wake an agent at rest.

sources.title: Agent metadata
sources.finding: Display-only metadata per pane: model, context percentage, cost reported by some protocols, plan progress, subagent summaries; capped and cleared when the agent leaves.

sources.title: CLI reference
sources.locator: tuios fan, start-agent, worktree, hosts, pair, update, mcp, doctor
sources.finding: Full command reference including fan, start-agent --protocol, worktree new/ls/pull, hosts add, pair, stdio-proxy, update and doctor.

sources.title: Control protocol
sources.finding: JSON verb protocol over the daemon socket with an integer version bumped only on incompatible change (pong shows protocol 22 in 0.9.5).

sources.title: Sessions guide
sources.locator: What Survives; Adding a Phone; Windows on Another Machine; Limitations
sources.finding: Daemon holds PTYs so detach loses nothing; daemon restart restores structure and history but not running programs; phone app unreleased (Android private testing); hosts over ssh; restored shells use the daemon environment.

sources.title: Web terminal guide
sources.locator: Who can connect; behind a reverse proxy
sources.finding: tuios-web serves a browser terminal with password, TLS and read-only options; every connected browser gets a shell on the machine.

sources.title: Hooks
sources.finding: Thirteen events (including after-agent-state, after-new-worktree, after-settle) run shell commands from the daemon even when no client is attached.

sources.title: Configuration
sources.locator: Turn off agent features; agents tables
sources.finding: Config.toml controls agents.enabled, approvals, permissions mode and grants, hosts and appearance.

sources.title: GoReleaser config
sources.finding: Release builds cover linux, darwin, windows (amd64 only; arm and arm64 ignored), freebsd and openbsd.

sources.title: tuios-web command
sources.finding: Separate tuios-web binary serves the terminal to browsers.

sources.title: MCP server implementation
sources.finding: Implements the tuios MCP tool server.

sources.title: Pull request integration
sources.finding: Wraps gh for pull request creation and status.

sources.title: Worktree implementation
sources.finding: Creates and manages git worktrees for fan and worktree commands.

sources.title: Push notification implementation
sources.finding: Sends web push and other push notifications for attention events.

sources.title: Go module file
sources.finding: Go module for the Charm-stack TUI (Bubble Tea v2); native binary, no GUI toolkit.

sources.title: Bundled skills
sources.finding: Ships agent skills; tuios --skill prints topic guides from the binary.

sources.title: Harness integration installer
sources.finding: Writes hooks, plugins, skills and MCP entries for harnesses.

sources.title: tuios AGENT_STATE Supported agents table
sources.locator: section Supported agents, table rows from Claude Code to Aider
sources.finding: The table lists 14 harnesses with hook, screen, title or herdr reporting plus further rows: Antigravity CLI, Devin CLI, Droid and Qoder CLI (session hook, screen); Grok CLI and Hermes Agent (session hook, screen, title); Cline, Goose, Maki, Letta Code (screen); Aider (process only, working and idle).

sources.title: tuios hook manager
sources.locator: Manager.Fire (each command runs in its own goroutine via inFlight.Go with run(cmdStr, ctx, 0)); Manager.Run and executeHook timeout handling
sources.finding: Fire starts every registered hook command for an event in its own goroutine with a zero (unbounded) timeout and records the last result per command; nothing serializes or retries a hook, while the separate Run path used for worktree setup runs commands in order with a timeout and stops at the first failure.
